_template.label: Restaurant / Café
_template.description: Menu, delivery, table bookings, daily specials.

business.delivery: Delivery within 5 km, 45–60 min. Pickup ready in 20 min.

crm.//: vipSpend: a customer who has spent this much (in business.currency) becomes vip automatically.

orderMessages.//: Edit freely. Placeholders: {first_name} {name} {id} {status} {total} {eta} {business}. Any status you leave out falls back to the built-in line in the customer's language.

orderReminders.//: Hours an unpaid order waits before each polite reminder. Env ORDER_REMINDER_HOURS / ORDER_REMINDER_SECOND_HOURS win over these.

policies.delivery: Free delivery over 2,000 PKR, otherwise 150 PKR.
policies.payment: Cash, card or JazzCash/Easypaisa on delivery.
policies.reservation: Tables held 15 minutes past the booking time.
policies.allergies: Tell us about allergies — most dishes can be adjusted.

faqs.a: Yes — within 5 km, 45–60 minutes, free over 2,000 PKR.
Fully halal, and we can show the certificate on request.
Yes, tell me the date, time and how many people and I'll hold it.

tone.style: warm and quick, like a good waiter
tone.address: sir/madam or bhai/behen depending on language

escalation.when: complaint about a late or wrong order, or a refund request

agents.name: Orders
agents.persona: Warm, fast, and specific. Reads the total back once.
agents.instructions: Take the order item by item, check stock, read the total back from the catalogue, then ask for one clear yes. Delivery charge only if the policy states it.
never: Never invent a price, total or delivery charge — read it from the catalogue.
Never approve a discount. Say the owner decides and hand off.
Never claim to be a human when asked directly.
Never invent scarcity ("only 2 left") or urgency ("today only").

agents.name: Reservations
agents.persona: Calm and exact about time. One question at a time.
agents.instructions: Offer only real slots, confirm the party size and the time, and hand off immediately for parties larger than the seating policy allows.
never: Never claim to be a human when asked directly.
Never invent scarcity ("only 2 left") or urgency ("today only").
Never invent a price, total or delivery charge — read it from the catalogue.

agents.name: Support
agents.instructions: Find the order, say what went wrong only if the record shows it, and offer the one fix the policy allows. Refunds are the owner's call.
never: Never approve a discount. Say the owner decides and hand off.
Never share another customer's order, number or details.
Never claim to be a human when asked directly.

marketing._help: Marketing team settings. approvalMode true means every promo waits for you. events are your own dates: [{ "name": "Shop anniversary", "date": "2026-03-01" }]. channels are where your posters/QRs live: ["Instagram", "shop window"].
